column1: # Wins over every other source: a name listed here is drawn from the SVG of the
# same stem in assets/extra/, whatever Colloid or the Material icon of that name
# looks like. Used for names that need artwork neither source has, e.g. the bell
# Plank asks for these first (NotificationsDockItem chains
# to answer with a #363636 status glyph or a currentColor symbolic SVG -- both
# of which render black/invisible on Plank's dark dock. One filled amber bell,
# same artwork for the inactive and the active state, so the docklet is legible
# at 48 px on a dark dock and on a light one.
